_: GENERATED — what an authoring tool needs to FIND an operation. The calling table is the .lua beside it.

operations.name: Create a post
operations.description: Create a draft or scheduled post for a publication via the REST API. Available only to publications on the Pro and Enterprise plans. Supply content with either `blocks` or `body_content` — exactly one of the two. Creation is asynchronous: this returns 201 with a stable post ID immediately, but the post is still being built. A follow-up `getPost` may return 202 while creation is in flight (retry, h

blocks.description: Structured content blocks (paragraph, image, heading, button, html, table, list, columns, …). Block schemas are documented in the full Fern reference.

body_content.description: Post content as a single raw HTML string, wrapped in an htmlSnippet block internally.

post_template_id.description: Template to render the post with. Defaults to the publication's default template.

status.description: `confirmed` publishes immediately, or at `scheduled_at` when supplied. A draft post cannot be scheduled.

operations.name: Create or upsert a subscriber
operations.description: Add a subscriber to a publication. Idempotent on email for the same publication when using matching upsert semantics — see developers.beehiiv.com for exact behavior.

operations.name: Curated agent index (llms txt)
operations.description: Returns the curated markdown index of beehiiv pages, when-to-use guidance, MCP tips, and CLI pointers.

operations.name: Download this open api document
operations.description: Returns the OpenAPI 3.1 JSON document describing public beehiiv agent endpoints and core REST operations. Prefer this file for function-calling tool generation.

operations.name: Fetch a marketing page as markdown
operations.description: Convert a live marketing HTML page into a clean markdown twin. Equivalent to requesting `/{path}.md` or sending `Accept: text/markdown` to the HTML URL. Homepage: omit path or use empty segments.

path.description: URL path without leading slash (e.g. `pricing`, `features/automations`). Use `index` for the homepage when calling this route directly.

operations.name: Get a publication by id
operations.description: Fetch a single publication (`pub_…` prefixed ID) from api.beehiiv.com/v2.

operations.name: Marketing mcp streamable http endpoint
operations.description: Model Context Protocol Streamable HTTP transport for marketing tools (`get_pricing`, `compare_with`, `get_company_facts`, `get_page_markdown`, `list_pages`, `pricing_faq`). Clients should send `Accept: application/json, text/event-stream`.

operations.name: List public marketing mcp tools (no auth)
operations.description: Public JSON catalog of tools exposed by the www.beehiiv.com marketing MCP server at `/api/mcp`. Product workspace MCP at https://mcp.beehiiv.com/mcp requires OAuth.

operations.name: List posts for a publication
operations.description: List newsletter posts (drafts and published) for a publication.

operations.name: List publications for the authenticated account
operations.description: REST API on api.beehiiv.com/v2. Returns publications the API key can access. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer `.

operations.name: List subscribers for a publication
operations.description: Paginated subscriber list for a publication. Filter by email, status, and expansion fields as documented on developers.beehiiv.com.

operations.name: Search help center, blog, and product updates
operations.description: Public search across beehiiv support articles, blog posts, and product updates from product.beehiiv.com. Returns ranked JSON hits with URLs (markdown twins available for articles/posts). Product updates are point-in-time release notes; their description starts with the publish date.
